title: Set up your business
summary: The full list of the step-by-step path of a company account, opened from the Próximo passo card of the Trabalho tab (ADR 0194 point 13). The server computes each step from records; the owner does not tick a step by hand.

id.description: profile, link, catalog, first_tool, seal or second_seat.

of.description: One step, in the order of the sector.

firstTool.description: The tool of the first_tool step.

openStep.effect: profile opens the profile edit screen, link opens the link and QR code screen and calls POST /v1/me/business/setup/link-opened, catalog opens catalog-owner, first_tool opens the owner screen of the tool, seal opens the CNPJ flow on the phone, second_seat opens the seats screen on the phone.

notes: An autônomo with no CNPJ does not get the seal step (ADR 0138): the server leaves it out.
The web shows the seal and second_seat steps as text with bipe_web_work_phone_only (ADR 0226 point 6).
